enterprise-contact-path-mining 1.0.1 Changelog

- Initial public release of the skill for enterprise contact path mining.
- Provides systematic analysis of enterprise contact channels, including official and indirect paths, opportunity-based contacts, and credibility grading.
- Generates actionable outreach strategies and supporting materials for business, investment, and government engagement scenarios.
- Ensures compliance with strict information sourcing and privacy protection standards.
- Includes detailed process for evaluating and prioritizing communication pathways, tailored by outreach purpose.
